Test build on upstream v0.3.5. Installs next to the regular Rakazo app.

Extra features on top of upstream:
- Receive shares from other Android apps (upstream PR #1563)
- Live working status on by default
- Keep unchanged messages when a polled snapshot arrives
- No pause between spoken sentences
- Android sheets fit the sheet on wide windows; avatar picker as a bottom sheet

Already in upstream: split view, double tap to react, drop files, scroll to a just-sent message, localised notifications (#1806), call foreground service (#1807).
